args.title: The Salt Sanctuary
args.subtitle: A fragrance journey through the quiet salt flats of Busan.
args.line: A sanctuary of absolute serenity where the scent of the sea dissolves into the white expanse.
args.synopsis: You step into a world of blinding whiteness, where the stillness of a salt desert greets you. Guided by a path of silence, you approach the pristine white salt mound standing as a solitary monument in the center. As you circle this void, you discover hidden perfume vessels nestled within the landscape, waiting to be found. Every breath here is a meditation, a delicate balance between the vastness of the space and the intimacy of the scent.
args.quote: In the vast silence of salt, even the smallest essence becomes an infinity.

why.d: This path draws you into the space, grounding you in the profound stillness of the salt desert.
This towering, pristine white salt mound creates a focal point that anchors the vast, empty room.
These subtle vessels encourage a tactile exploration of the space, turning discovery into a ritual.
The minimalist block offers a quiet, final anchor before you leave the sanctuary of the salt.
